title: "Flashcards"

<section class="practice-setup" id="card-setup"><div class="filter-row"><label for="card-topic">Topic<select id="card-topic"></select></label><label for="card-lesson">Lesson<select id="card-lesson"></select></label><label for="card-kind">Material<select id="card-kind"><option value="all">All material</option><option value="Vocabulary">Vocabulary only</option><option value="Rules &amp; patterns">Rules &amp; patterns only</option><option value="Examples">Worked examples only</option></select></label></div><div class="filter-row compact"><label for="card-direction">Vocabulary direction<select id="card-direction"><option value="forward">French → English</option><option value="reverse">English → French</option></select></label><label for="card-length">Session size<select id="card-length"><option value="10" selected>10 cards</option><option value="20">20 cards</option><option value="50">50 cards</option><option value="all">All matching cards</option></select></label><label class="checkbox-label"><input id="card-unlearned" type="checkbox"> Only cards I’m still learning</label></div><div class="setup-bottom"><p id="card-available" aria-live="polite"></p><button id="card-start" type="button" class="button">Start practising</button></div></section>

<section id="card-play" hidden><div class="practice-top"><span id="card-position"></span><span id="card-session-score"></span></div><button class="flashcard" id="flashcard" type="button" aria-label="Reveal answer" aria-pressed="false"><span class="eyebrow" id="card-label"></span><span id="card-front" class="flashcard-front"></span><span id="card-back" class="flashcard-back" hidden></span><span id="card-hint" class="flip-hint">Click to reveal the answer</span></button><a id="card-lesson-link" class="small-link" href="lessons.html">Open the lesson</a><div id="card-rating" class="card-rating"><button type="button" id="card-again" class="button secondary" disabled>Still learning</button><button type="button" id="card-known" class="button" disabled>I know this</button></div><div class="quiz-bottom"><button id="card-end" type="button" class="text-button">End session</button><span class="small-note">Space to flip · 1 to repeat · 2 if known</span></div></section>

<section id="card-results" class="results-panel" hidden tabindex="-1"><p class="eyebrow">Session complete</p><h2 id="card-result-title"></h2><p id="card-result-detail"></p><div class="hero-actions"><button id="card-repeat" type="button" class="button">Repeat learning cards</button><button id="card-new" type="button" class="button secondary">Choose another deck</button></div></section>
<p class="privacy-note"><button class="text-button" id="clear-mastery" type="button">Reset card progress</button></p>
